notes: Live broker (real accounts). Real-account tools are read-only this phase except da_put_draft, which writes a draft into the scratch folder and always needs the owner's approval (set in code, not here). The DA reads (da_list, da_get) run without approval since 2026-11-13: approving every call took Jack 3 approvals for one small job, and he chose approval on writes only. To put a read back behind approval, add it to approval_required. An admin override in KV (PUT /admin/api/policy) takes precedence until it is deleted.
